name: project-problems
description: Every error in the project in the Problems panel, including files you have not opened: TypeScript, Vue, Svelte, Astro and ESLint.
author: Fuad Laguda

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Project Problems runs the project's own checkers (TypeScript, vue-tsc, svelte-check, astro check, ESLint) from its node_modules, so it only runs in trusted folders.

projectProblems.enable.description: Check every project in the workspace and show its problems, including files that are not open.

enumDescriptions: Keep each TypeScript or vue-tsc compiler running; it updates whenever a file changes. Svelte, Astro and ESLint checks run on save.
Check when you save a file. Lighter on large projects.
Check when you run "Project Problems: Recheck All Projects", and once on opening (unless turned off below).

projectProblems.checkOnStartup.description: In manual mode, check once when the workspace opens or these settings change. Otherwise only on Recheck.

projectProblems.eslint.enable.description: Also lint the whole project with the project's own ESLint and config, on save. Needs ESLint installed in the project and an ESLint config file.

projectProblems.eslint.paths.description: What ESLint checks, relative to each workspace folder.

projectProblems.exclude.description: tsconfig files matching these globs are not checked.

projectProblems.maxProjects.description: The most tsconfig projects to check at once. Each runs its own checker.

scripts.test: esbuild test/parse.test.ts test/tsconfig.test.ts test/security.test.ts test/tools.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outdir=.test-build --out-extension:.js=.mjs --log-level=warning && node --test .test-build/parse.test.mjs .test-build/tsconfig.test.mjs .test-build/security.test.mjs .test-build/tools.test.mjs
scripts.check:host: npm run build && esbuild test/host/suite.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:vscode --outfile=.test-build/host-suite.cjs --log-level=warning && esbuild test/host/run.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=.test-build/host-run.cjs --log-level=warning && node .test-build/host-run.cjs
